text:
miriam: Kickoff  planning thread  we need a distilled roadmap for dedicated pools: tiered burst shaping, quota decay semantics, preemption windows, and launch gates. Customers pressing for clarity.

pat: Can we categorize decisions into Pilot vs GA? Ops capacity is constrained so pilot must be lean.

logan: Pilot must-haves: deterministic spill ordering, per-tenant envelope summary in Console, and concrete autoscale damping. GA can include rollover options and SLA language.

sara: Customer ask from Finch & Nova: a soft-fence mode where a tenant can opt into "best-effort isolation" vs "strict isolation". They want predictable behavior when envelopes hit.

miriam: Proposed definitions:
- strict-isolation: no spill_to_shared, tenant preempted only if contract eviction allowed; page legal for SLA.
- soft-fence: default for self-serve, allows spill_to_shared but with prioritized repair (autoscale + predictive warm).

pat: Autoscale proposal: dual-threshold + damping. Scale-up if sustained occupancy > 72% for 8m; scale-down if < 48% for 12m. Enforce min_scale_interval = 12m. This reduced thrash in tests.

logan: Preemption window: if we must preempt, prefer short-lived sessions first and avoid preempting in-flight generation where possible. Suggest "preempt_grace=15s" and preempt_order = [low_priority_session, oldest_session, in_flight_safe_kill].

sara: Billing nuance: customers asked how unused burst shows up on invoices. Proposal: pilot = no automatic rollover; show an "Allowance" line item and report daily decay. GA add-on = Rollover Pack.

miriam: Quota decay models discussed: linear vs exponential. Ops + Finance prefer linear decay with configurable window (default 7d) to make disputes simpler. Anyone object?

pat: Linear OK. Add a decay_log event for billing reconciliation: reserve.decay_applied with previous/remaining tokens in telemetry.

logan: UX mocks: Console card: "Burst envelope: 40k / 5m | Used 28k | Mode: soft-fence". Click expands to history and policy toggle (strict vs soft). Pilot only needs summary + 80% alert.

sara: Customers want a "burst forecast" badge (low/med/high) for next 15m. We can surface predictive smoothing later as opt-in. Keep pilot simple.

miriam: Launch criteria (pilot-ready):
1) deterministic spill order implemented
2) Console envelope card + 80% alert
3) autoscale damping & min_scale_interval enforced
4) billing events: burst.grant, burst.consume, reserve.decay_applied, spill.to_shared
5) oncall runbook for full-spill incidents
If all met, we can onboard 3 pilot customers.

pat: I'll own infra + runbook. Will add metric: shared_pool_spill_rate pct and tenant_spill_concentration. Page if shared_pool_spill_rate > 0.5% for 5m.

logan: I'll own Console & API surfaces. Will add config snippet for runtime: ```yaml
reserve:
  spill_order: [tenant_priority, session_age]
  envelope_tokens: 40000
  envelope_window: 5m
  decay_window_days: 7
  isolation_mode: soft-fence
  autoscale:
    up_threshold_pct: 72
    up_duration_mins: 8
    down_threshold_pct: 48
    down_duration_mins: 12
    min_scale_interval_mins: 12
  preempt_grace_secs: 15
```

sara: GTM ask: label "Rollover Pack" in docs. For pilot, include a clear sentence: "Default: no rollover; contact sales for rollover options." Legal to sign off on strict-isolation wording.

deploy-bot: feature-flag created: reserve.tiered_burst_pilot (internal).

miriam: Timeline: infra + runtime changes 3w, Console + telemetry 4w, docs & billing hooks 2w after flag. Owners assigned: pat (infra), logan (console + api), sara (GTM + contracts), miriam (product).

pat: I'll draft runbook today and post to eng-oncall. Expect an initial PR for spill_order enforcement tomorrow.

logan: I'll mock Console card this afternoon and share in product channel.

sara: I'll draft the one-pager for sales and loop legal on isolation verbiage.

miriam: Good. Next sync Thursday 9am to confirm pilot customer list and objection items. Keep replies short here. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
